text:
Nora: Hey team — prepping the changelog + release notes for next Friday's docs deploy. Key items: deprecate old embed helpers (embed_stream/embed), update snippets for the JS rename (jsClient -> client), fix a moved anchor in the migration guide, and decide whether to add a short deprecation schedule line. Who can own snippets, redirects, and the final relnotes copy?

Diego: I can handle snippets. Tests show the old helper `client.embed_stream()` blows up with 400. New recommended usage: `client.embeddings.create({ model: "rwd-embed-2", input: "text" })`. I'll open a PR with JS + Python minimal examples and a one-line diff in the migration guide.

Rachel: I'll take redirects. LinkScanner flagged `guides/migration/embedding.md#embedding-legacy` -> the file moved to `migration/embedding-v2.md#legacy-embeddings`. I'll add a _redirects.yaml entry and update the internal link.

Nora: Thanks. Also product asked for a tidy deprecation line: short bullet in relnotes + link to a deprecation schedule page. Draft: "Deprecation: legacy embed helpers (embed_stream, embed) will be retired on 2025-07-01. Please migrate to client.embeddings.create() — see Embeddings migration guide." Thoughts?

Diego: That date's fine. Keep relnotes concise: one sentence plus pointer to the schedule. Migration guide will contain the diffs and examples.

docs-bot: LinkScanner: detected 1 broken anchor in guides/migration/embedding.md -> '#embedding-legacy' (404).

Rachel: Redirect PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2481 Added old anchor -> migration/embedding-v2.md#legacy-embeddings and updated the page link. Tagging infra for expedited review.

infra-bot: NOTE: Redirects merged after 08:15 UTC will be included in the next deploy window. Please merge accordingly.

Nora: Diego, can you include the final example in the relnotes and keep the diff only in the migration guide? That matches our style. Also add a one-line known-issue: "Older SDKs (<0.9) may return 4xx on legacy embed calls."

Diego: Will do. I'll open PR with snippet + changelog line and reference Rachel's redirect PR in the description. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2482

Rachel: Infra approved the redirect; merging once CI green.

Nora: Checklist before I publish:
- Diego: snippet PR with examples + short relnotes example (assigned)
- Rachel: redirect merged and infra confirmation (assigned)
- Nora: publish relnotes with one-line deprecation + pointer to schedule (assigned)

Diego: Quick question: do we want to show a one-line diff in the relnotes or save that solely for migration guide? My vote: only final example in relnotes.

Rachel: Agreed. Keep relnotes scannable. Diffs belong in migration docs.

Nora: Agreed. I'll draft relnotes after both PRs are merged and post for a quick signoff in #docs. If anyone sees more stale anchors, run `make linkcheck` or ping docs-bot to re-scan. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: Deploy Bot: reminder — docs build queue at 09:00 UTC. Redirects merged after 08:15 UTC will go out in the following deploy.
